<h1>SimpleAudioPlayer 使用手册（一）：介绍+快速入门</h1>
<h2>引言</h2>
<p>.NET 生态中音频播放库的选择并不多。NAudio 功能完善但仅限 Windows，而跨平台方案往往需要引入庞大臃肿的依赖。<strong>SimpleAudioPlayer</strong> 以"小而美"为宗旨，用不到 4000 行 C# 代码 + 一个精简的 C 原生库，实现了跨平台的高性能音频播放、录制与流媒体支持。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>项目地址：https://github.com/j4587698/SimpleAudioPlayer</p>
<h2>技术栈</h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>
<p>层次</p>
</th><th>
<p>技术</p>
</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>
<p>语言</p>
</td>
<td>
<p>C# (.NET 8/9/10) + C99 (原生库)</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>
<p>音频后端</p>
</td>
<td>
<p>miniaudio (Public Domain，单头文件库)</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>
<p>音频解码</p>
</td>
<td>
<p>FFmpeg 7.1 (libavformat, libavcodec, libswresample, libavutil)</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>
<p>原生互操作</p>
</td>
<td>
<p><code data-backticks="1">[LibraryImport]</code> Source-Generated P/Invoke</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>
<p>原生构建</p>
</td>
<td>
<p>CMake 3.20+, MSYS2 MinGW (Windows), GCC/Clang (macOS/Linux)</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>
<p>NuGet 打包</p>
</td>
<td>
<p>SimpleAudioPlayer.Native 作为预编译原生 NuGet 包分发</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h2>安装</h2>
<div class="toastui-editor-ww-code-block" data-language="bash">
<pre><code data-language="bash">dotnet add package SimpleAudioPlayer --version 2.3.1</code></pre>
</div>
<h2>最简单的播放</h2>
<div class="toastui-editor-ww-code-block" data-language="csharp">
<pre><code data-language="csharp">using SimpleAudioPlayer;
using SimpleAudioPlayer.Handles;

var player = new AudioPlayer();
player.Load(new FileStreamHandler("song.mp3"));
player.Play();</code></pre>
</div>
<p>三步：创建播放器 -&gt; Load(文件句柄) -&gt; Play()。</p>
<h2>播放控制</h2>
<div class="toastui-editor-ww-code-block" data-language="csharp">
<pre><code data-language="csharp">player.Play();     // 返回 bool，true 成功
player.Pause();    // 暂停
player.Stop();     // 停止（回到开头）
player.Seek(30);   // 跳转到 30 秒</code></pre>
</div>
<h2>时间信息</h2>
<div class="toastui-editor-ww-code-block" data-language="csharp">
<pre><code data-language="csharp">double current = player.Time;      // 当前秒数
double total = player.Duration;    // 总时长秒数</code></pre>
</div>
<h2>音量</h2>
<div class="toastui-editor-ww-code-block" data-language="csharp">
<pre><code data-language="csharp">player.Volume = 0.5;  // 0.0~1.0</code></pre>
</div>
<h2>事件</h2>
<div class="toastui-editor-ww-code-block" data-language="csharp">
<pre><code data-language="csharp">player.PlaybackStateChanged = state =&gt; Console.WriteLine(state);
player.PlaybackFailed = args =&gt; Console.WriteLine(args.Result);
player.PlayCompleted = () =&gt; Console.WriteLine("完成");</code></pre>
</div>
<h2>完整示例</h2>
<div class="toastui-editor-ww-code-block" data-language="csharp">
<pre><code data-language="csharp">using SimpleAudioPlayer;
using SimpleAudioPlayer.Handles;

var player = new AudioPlayer();
player.PlaybackStateChanged = state =&gt; Console.WriteLine($"状态: {state}");
player.PlaybackFailed = args =&gt; Console.WriteLine($"失败: {args.Result}");
player.PlayCompleted = () =&gt; Console.WriteLine("完成");

player.Load(new FileStreamHandler("song.mp3"));
Console.WriteLine($"时长: {player.Duration:F1}s");
player.Play();
Thread.Sleep(5000);
player.Stop();
player.Dispose();</code></pre>
</div>
<h2>错误处理</h2>
<div class="toastui-editor-ww-code-block" data-language="csharp">
<pre><code data-language="csharp">try {
    player.Load(new FileStreamHandler("nonexistent.mp3"));
}
catch (InvalidOperationException ex) {
    Console.WriteLine($"加载失败: {ex.Message}");
}</code></pre>
</div>
<h2>Dispose</h2>
<div class="toastui-editor-ww-code-block" data-language="csharp">
<pre><code data-language="csharp">using var player = new AudioPlayer();
// 或 player.Dispose()</code></pre>
</div>

</div>
